1101: Information on the available general OS commands
1104:
Performs specified configurations to an offline 
                            image.
1105:
/Optimize-Image {/WimBoot | /Boot}

  Performs specified configurations to an offline image. 

  Use /WIMBoot to configure an offline image for installing on a 
  WIMBoot system. 

  Use /Boot to try and reduce the online configuration time that 
  the OS spends during boot. Note that this optimization may be 
  rendered invalid if any servicing operations are performed on the 
  image after optimizing it. 

    Examples: 
      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline 
        /Optimize-Image /WimBoot 

      DISM.exe /Image:C:\test\offline 
        /Optimize-Image /Boot
